# orchestration_checkout_tool

> Check out your orchestration stage context including full artifact content from prior stages.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `orchestration` |
| Callable | MCP clients; grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=orchestration_checkout_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Check out your orchestration stage context including full artifact content
from prior stages. You MUST call this before starting any work.

Returns: stage execution ID (for completion), expected outputs, agent config
constraints, and the required input artifacts (specs, designs, task lists).
Small artifacts are inlined in full; large ones are summarized with an
llm_file_id — call read_llm_file_tool for their full content when you need it.
Also includes rejection feedback and prior attempt summaries if this is a retry.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `orchestration_stage_execution_id` | integer | yes | Your stage execution ID (from the orchestration prompt) |
